next.reason: 1985 only points the report file's SAME clause to the Sequential I-O SAME clause; its format allows SAME AREA (no RECORD phrase) for a report file (SR XIII.2.4.3-2). 2023 keeps the file-area format (FMT 12.4.6.4.2), §2023:12.4.6.4.3 SR5 'A given file-name that represents a report file may be specified in one file-area format SAME clause' and §2023:12.4.6.4.4 GR1 'are to use the same memory area during processing'. Record-area GR2 does not apply to a report file.
